Risk Scenario: Privileged roles are assigned without approval or periodic review leading to unauthorised administrative changes
Cause: Manual role assignment and no PIM governance
Treatment Action: Enable approval workflow and monthly privileged role access review

Risk Scenario: Security events are not retained or monitored across critical systems
Cause: Default logging and missing SIEM connector coverage
Treatment Action: Centralise critical logs define retention and review connector health monthly
Notes: Align retention with audit period and licence limits

Risk Scenario: Legacy protocols bypass modern authentication and increase account compromise risk
Cause: Older clients or service accounts still use legacy authentication
Treatment Action: Block legacy authentication and document approved exceptions
Notes: Track exceptions with owner and expiry
